{{DISPLAYTITLE:Sprite (''Tactics Advance'')}}
[[File:FFTA-spr-sprite.gif|left]]
[[File:Sprite - Status.gif|right]]
{{Quote|Not the sprite of tales. A dangerous beastie.|Description}}
The '''Sprite''' in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'' is a fairy-type [[Monster (term)|monster]] who has the [[Float (ability)|Float]] ability and absorbs [[Holy (element)|Holy]]-based attacks. Sprite has low Attack and Defense, but high Magic Resistance and Magic Power. Its [[White Wind]] skill is a powerful healing tool, so the player should eliminate it with a strong physical attack in one shot.

==Appearances==
===Missions===
{|class="full-width FFTA article-table"
|-
!style="width:30%"|Mission
!style="width:70%"|Information
|-
!Turf Defense Mission: Help Eluut!
|While there is no Sprite in the Antlions clan, it helps them attack Eluut.
|-
!Turf Defense Mission: Help Salika!
|The Sprite duo and a [[Titania (Tactics Advance)|Titania]] appear in this turf defense mission.
|-
!Turf Defense Mission: Help Kudik!
|The Sprite here will spend much of its time using White Wind on its two [[Red Panther (Tactics Advance)|Red Panther]] allies.
|-
!Turf Defense Mission: Help Helje!
|The Sprite will play the part of healer in this Turf Defense mission, since all the other monsters will attempt to strike with physical attacks.
|-
!Mission #001: Herb Picking
|The first Sprite does not know any Trick skills and will instead opt for weak melee attacks.
|-
!Mission #049: A Lost Ring
|One Sprite starts out on the edge of the river in this mission.
|-
!Mission #048: S.O.S 
|Marche and co. will have to make their way through two Sprites and a Juggler before assisting [[Ritz Malheur|Ritz]] with the [[Zombie (Tactics Advance)|Zombies]].
|-
!Mission #109: Snow Fairy
|The Snow Fairy wants some Cyril Ice, if given the item, she will give an Iceprism, but to keep the Mission Item, it and its two allies can be defeated easily.
|-
!Mission #051: Desert Rose
|A Sprite helps defend the entrance to the oasis.
|-
!Mission #054: For A Song
|The Sprite here can keep her dangerous allies at optimum HP levels with her skills.
|}
